newsitem.title: USA: Newpark Resources sets 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Newpark Resources sets 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: Newpark Resources Inc said its board has approved a two-for-one split of the company's common stock for shareholders of record as of May 30.
It said the board has also authorized an increase in the number of its authorized shares of common stock to 80 million from 20 million.

Newpark said both proposals are to be submitted for stockholder vote at the company's regular stockholders meeting on May 14, 1997. Newpark Resources had 15,153,189 shares of common stock outstanding as of March 3.
